name: youthumb-ai
description: Create YouTube thumbnails with YouThumb.ai from your agent: MCP server (sign in, no key) or REST API, persons, assets, prompt method, and one project per thumbnail.

interface.shortDescription: AI YouTube thumbnails from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Create YouTube thumbnails with YouThumb.ai: connect the MCP server (sign in, approve the rights, choose the organization) or use the REST API; set up persons and assets, write strong prompts and iterate inside one project per thumbnail.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a YouTube thumbnail for my next video with YouThumb.
